maxLines.hint: The README keeps the fundamentals. Move the detail to a topic file in docs/, and link it from the README.
CLAUDE.md names only the rules that people break. Move the rest to CONTRIBUTING.md or docs/.
AGENTS.md names only the rules that people break. Move the rest to CONTRIBUTING.md or docs/.
CONTRIBUTING.md holds the rules that a contributor must follow. Move recipes, traps and troubleshooting to docs/<topic>.md, and link them.
An ADR gives the context, the decision and the consequences. Link the evidence, and do not copy it.
A topic file covers one topic. Split it by subtopic, and link the parts.
